name: Jackpot Dungeon
detailed_description:
Gather your coins and take a chance on fate in Jackpot Dungeon, a rogue-lite where every spin could bring fortune… or doom. Equip unique tokens, build powerful skill decks, and dive deeper into a dungeon where betting is your only weapon.

Instead of swinging swords or shooting arrows, you equip tokens—like enchanted shields, bombs, lucky ducks, and cursed skulls—and spin the slot machine. Your gear determines what can appear on each spin, so building a smart setup is key.

Pick your fighter from a cast of quirky, cursed adventurers—each with unique skills and playstyles. Our three main characters are:

A war hero known across battlefields for losing all his spoils of war in casinos. His warrior might and brute strength help him power through the riskiest scenarios. Good luck to any enemy who tries to take his gold. 

A not-so-renowned professor from the magic academy who mastered the forbidden Magic Loan spell in a bid to become the richest wizard in history. Once that happens, the students and teachers who mocked him will regret their ridicule. With his various spells and magic money to bet, he always has something to bet and the resources to make use of it. Or so he thinks.

The best thief alive, and nearly an unemployed one. She's wanted in every city and owes money to nearly every criminal organization. She may not seem dangerous at first, but once she's had a few drinks, she's anything but discreet. Her guild sent her into the Jackpot Dungeon to earn enough to pay off her debt to them. By stealthily manipulating the spin results and landing critical strikes, she might have a chance to pay everything she owes.

More playable heroes await to be unlocked, including (but not limited to) a priestess who enters the Jackpot Dungeon praying to her god to help her win the bets by increasing her luck stats and a Barbarrian who receives more and more buffs the higher she bets.

In Jackpot Dungeon you'll find no friends and many enemies. They'll block your way, rip your money bag, poison you, stab you, try to sell you stuff and do anything to make you lose your money! You'll need to get past them, clear each dungeon floor and defeat the boss of each floor to reach the treasure room at the core of the dungeon.

These enemies will act just like the players. They have their turn to play and their skills to use. Except they have skills to make you lose your betted money, or worse. Also, not all enemies will attack you directly, if I were you I'd be careful when buying items from that shop.

When you're betting, your most reliable resource is your deck of skills. Skills can freeze reels, eliminate cursed tokens, stun enemies, or even request a magic loan so you can keep betting. Each skill costs stamina, so choose wisely when and how to use them. You'll find a variety of Skill Cards to build your deck as you venture through the dungeon. You can also buy some from the shop, but I wouldn't recommend it.

Thank you for your attention and please look forward to Jackpot Dungeon release!

short_description: A rogue-lite slot-machine-based game where betting is your only weapon. Gather your life savings, enter the Jackpot Dungeon, and gamble your way to endless riches! Jackpot Dungeon is a game about betting your money and your life on a slot machine!
